properties.displayName: Bastion: block deletion of resources tagged bastion-protected
properties.description: Pattern of the Azure Landing Zones policy DenyAction-DeleteResources, keyed on a tag instead of a name. Blocks DELETE of any resource tagged bastion-protected=true, and of its resource group (cascadeBehaviors). Used for the policy remediation identity. DenyAction supports only the delete action.

metadata.source: pattern of Azure Landing Zones library DenyAction-DeleteResources v1.0.0 (commit 124b242, MIT licence)

metadata.description: Resources with this tag set to true are protected
